PATH AND PROTOCOL
- Server/Program.fs:100-106 MCP stateless HTTP; Server/McpTools.fs:2491-2504 passes argsJson STRING, no specific cap there. Client/SignalR/Client.fs:668-702 checks script file bytes, parses args BEFORE bridge cap. Execute :442-451 repeats raw check and parses; :488-501 serializes JsonElement args in default .NET full frame, not original raw string. send/read :125-149 check 400000 full message bytes and bounded fragment accumulation. Extension background.js:418-419 checks UTF-8 source and JSON.stringify(args) <=65536 after parsing; :443-462 builds exact invocation source+args+URL wrapper and checks 140000; then userScripts.execute. Raw input, compact JS args and escaped wire frame differ; nested MCP/SignalR args strings add further escapes. Full frame may fail after tab creation even if raw args accepted. Precompute deterministic envelope before effect where possible, keep actual send/receive checks.
- Server/Program.fs:108-115 sets SERVER incoming hub max 12 MiB, not server-to-client command cap. MapHub :140, Client/Program.fs:393-402 defaults; MS docs https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/signalr/configuration?view=aspnetcore-10.0 distinguish 64 KiB transport buffer/backpressure vs default 32 KiB hub receive limit. Kestrel default HTTP body 30,000,000 bytes https://learn.microsoft.com/aspnet/core/fundamentals/servers/kestrel/security-considerations; docs/security/NginxL7Exposure2026-11-12.md:39 flags Nginx default 1 MiB HTTP body, not WS message. Live proxy unverified. MCP UTF-8 JSON-RPC POST spec https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/basic/transports no stated 64 KiB cap; SDK ModelContextProtocol.AspNetCore 2.1.0 (Server/Server.fsproj:68). WebSocket RFC6455 sec5.2 uses 64-bit extended length, not 64 KiB maximum https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6455.html. Chrome userScripts ScriptSource.code is string, no documented 64 KiB/24k limit https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/reference/api/userScripts; separate runtime messaging 64 MiB and native host protocol not this path. ChatGPT platform argument limits, provider composer and Edge IPC thresholds unresolved; no claim of unlimited provider capacity.

RECOMMENDATIONS
P2 real contract mismatch, not evidence numeric bridge cap is necessary. Don't subtract 13/reserve guessed metadata: wrong encoding and ignores whole frame. Distinguish pure deterministic render success from transport readiness; bound template/expansion for actual record/read resource constraints. At shared pre-effect launch boundary validate exact composed args and full encoded frame, before tab creation; extension still validates actual invocation. Standardize compact typed encoding where safe, consolidate duplicate raw checks. Remove arbitrary 24k and 128k prompt caps and redundant raw prompt cap where actual output/expansion and transport-resource budgets replace them; retain explicit errors and actual bounded frame/response/read checks. Re-evaluate 65536/400000/140000 jointly using real size overhead, offline browser/IPC and concurrency/memory evidence, not arbitrary multipliers. Acceptance: exact/adjacent compact and default JSON/metadata/Unicode/escaped-frame cases, both scripts, schedule validation, no tab created for rejected input, no truncation or changed prompt, no replay. Actual provider/IPC tests require scoped authorization. Native Scheduler wiring separate lease. No implementation, production changes or activation.
